delivery_failures.title: Three ways oxygen delivery fails, told apart (anaemia, haemorrhage, dehydration) and what fixes each
delivery_failures.source: DO2 = CO x 1.34 x Hb x SaO2 x 10: each failure takes a different term. Treatment differs: iron and food for anaemia (weeks), stopping the bleeding and fluids for haemorrhage (the period had no transfusion: fluids by mouth, rest, and the marrow's weeks), water and salt for dehydration (hours). events.title: Conditional cardiovascular events (never a random roll on a healthy body)
events.source: Atherosclerosis develops over years (lipids, pressure, tobacco, the sugar sickness, age, inflammation damaging the endothelium); infarction follows plaque rupture or erosion with a clot blocking coronary flow (CIR-MI); arrhythmias follow electrolyte disturbance (potassium under 3.0 or over 6.0), hypoxia, drugs (NEUROLOGY: alcohol withdrawal, stimulants, quinine at high dose), scarred heart muscle; sudden death in a young crew is rare and usually structural (the one with the hidden heart). The chance formulas are placeholders; the shape is the clinical one. Rex, 2026-10-29: named characters are vulnerable to these events; all the events the biology supports are in; a failure is a crisis, never a death by itself (ANATOMY 3a).
rows: the old captain's angina on the stairs; the merchant's short breath
